text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was the new year, and as I was contemplating Maruzensky's training with a fresh mindset—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hii, Trainer-kun.
Happy New Year☆

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hii, Trainer-chan.
Happy New Year☆

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I wondered if you might be here, so I came to check,
and seeing you really here surprised me!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You were working right from the start of the new year?
choice_data_list: Because I want you to have fun running.
Because I want you to enjoy running.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Fun... huh.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, if they really think that highly of me,
I have to live up to their expectations!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So? What exactly are you trying
to make me do, Trainer-kun?
choice_data_list: I want to push my natural speed even further!
I want to thoroughly manage my health!
I want to add more racing styles to my strengths!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So? What exactly are you trying
to make me do, Trainer-chan?
choice_data_list: I want to push my natural speed even further!
I want to thoroughly manage my health!
I want to add more racing styles to my strengths!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I see you want to watch an even more explosive run.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Running even faster than this would certainly feel amazing, wouldn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Okay, roger that!
I'll make sure to be mindful of it in my own training!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, and here I thought you'd be doing some kind of hardcore training.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Still, you can't even train in the first place if you're not in good health, right?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Understood, I'll be careful myself too.
Even if it's New Year's, I must make sure not to overeat!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, paying attention to things other than speed?
Impressive!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Considering we'll be running in all sorts of races,
I think broadening your skillset is essential.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'll keep that in mind too!
Maybe I should try drifting around turns...?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: You've been working so hard for me right from the start of the new year, Trainer-kun~.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "You've been working hard for my sake right from the start of the new year, haven't you, Trainer-chan~?"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
To tell you the truth, though, I've worked hard right from New Year's Day
for the sake of my cute junior before.
choice_data_list: What is it you're working so hard on?
What are you working so hard on?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'll show you how it's done, so will you watch?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After saying that, Maruzensky lays a tablecloth
over the desk and begins setting out cups.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Here we go... and, hup!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Snap!!)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ta-da! The tablecloth pull!
Our underclassmen are gonna love this, no doubt about it!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: When you think of New Year's, you think of 'party tricks,' don't you~!
choice_data_list: A "talent show"... that brings back memories...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Huh... Nostalgic...?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"No way!? They don't air the 'Hidden Talents' show on TV anymore?
Even though it's New Year's!?"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...*ahem* Well, the goal is to make them happy,
nostalgia doesn't matter! Right, right...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, a brand new year with Maruzensky kicked off.
